method.availability_handling: SOFR-minus-DFF innovations are neutral-zero coded before SOFR inception rather than imputed as observations; DFF and weekly CFTC open interest provide full-window policy/liquidity coverage.
method.domain_balance: each standardized variable weighted by inverse square root of its domain signature count
method.edge_inference: retrospective descriptive subsequent-outcome association from nonoverlapping persistence-confirmed episode onsets; not OOS or predictive alpha evidence
method.episodes: retrospectively estimated from a full-sample PCA/rotation basis; persistence confirmed on the third consecutive threshold hit with no onset backfill or inactive-gap inclusion
method.factor_extraction: eigendecomposition of robust standardized covariance matrix
method.factor_selection: 95th-percentile deterministic parallel analysis using independent within-column permutations
method.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg correction separately across all retained-process XAU edges, examined transition edges, and examined interaction edges
method.retrospective_representation_boundary: The atlas factor basis uses full-sample covariance and rotation. Atlas episodes are retrospective descriptive states, unsuitable as real-time or predictive states. Only the separate walk-forward benchmark refits its basis within each training fold.
method.rotation: orthogonal varimax with deterministic sign and ordering
method.standardization: median/MAD robust z-score, fallback standard deviation, clipped to +/-8
method.validation: four leave-chronological-block-out training models with exact optimal Tucker assignment; three purged and embargoed expanding walk-forward folds

process_frame.point_in_time_warning: Observation-date rows without historical release timestamps or vintages do not establish point-in-time safety.
